description: Implement EncoderBackend using x264 (H.264) and libvpx (VP8/VP9) for systems with no hardware encoder support or when HW encoders are occupied. Uses CPU readback from capture texture. Tuned presets for real-time (ultrafast/realtime). Serves as the universal fallback — every Windows machine can record, even without a dedicated GPU. Also used for GIF export pipeline.
title: Software encoder fallback (x264/libvpx) for no-GPU path
